name: create_grating
description: Dynamically constructs a new Bending Grating and attaches it to a base model in the parameter graph.

inputs.name: model_id
inputs.description: ID of the base model to bind the grating to.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Custom display name for the newly created grating.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Layer override addresses and kernel configuration elements.
